requirement.description: The View.__getattr__ method incorrectly raises AttributeError when accessing non-existent fields instead of providing helpful error messages with field suggestions. Additionally, it doesn't properly handle reserved field names (starting with underscore) that should only be accessed via indexing.
requirement.contract: When accessing a non-existent field via attribute access on a View, the method should raise an AttributeError with a message suggesting similar field names. When accessing a reserved field name (starting with underscore) via attribute access, it should raise an AttributeError indicating that the field can only be accessed by indexing.

requirement.description: The View.__getitem__ method doesn't properly validate indexing operations for non-array layouts when using value-based indices. It should raise a TypeError with a descriptive message when attempting to index non-array layouts with values.
requirement.contract: When attempting to index a View with a value (not an integer) that has a non-ArrayLayout, the method should raise a TypeError with the message "Only views with array layout, not {layout_name}, may be indexed with a value".

requirement.description: The View.__getitem__ method doesn't properly handle indexing with missing keys. It should raise a KeyError with the missing key when trying to access a non-existent field in a layout.
requirement.contract: When attempting to access a non-existent field in a layout via __getitem__, the method should raise a KeyError with the missing key as the argument.

requirement.description: The View.__getattr__ method doesn't properly handle attribute access to fields that are reserved (start with underscore) - it should raise an error instead of allowing access.
requirement.contract: When accessing a field name that starts with underscore via attribute access, the method should raise an AttributeError with the message "View of {target} field '{field_name}' has a reserved name and may only be accessed by indexing".

requirement.description: The _convert_to_int method in Layout class doesn't correctly validate reset values for UnionLayout when passed as dictionaries. It should raise appropriate errors when reset values don't conform to UnionLayout constraints.
requirement.contract: When a UnionLayout has a reset value passed as a dictionary with more than one field specified, it should raise a ValueError with the message "Initializer for at most one field can be provided for a union layout (specified: ...)"
